description: S458: an array of a refinement (`string(url)[]`) is judged element by element. A literal initializer is judged statically: the second element `javascript:alert(1)` fails `url`, so E-CONTRACT-001. (On base the `[]` was read as an empty label and the whole array was judged as one string; during S458 slice 1 the array was briefly unchecked.)
rationale: §53.3.1: the predicate is evaluated over the incoming value at every binding site — for an array of `string(url)`, every element is such a value; §53.4.2 rule 2 + §53.11: a string literal that fails a named shape is E-CONTRACT-001.
